body:
[aida:product] BUG-1546 reworked and pushed (08834c6045). Two asks: un-shelve it, and rule on the reviewer's F3. Then I start #2026.

REWORK DONE. The reviewer refused #2048 on one blocking finding and it was a real one: my doc comment quoted "41 of 147 sha-bearing records", but compare_shas is reached only through a filter on reviewed_sha, so the 42 head-only records are dropped upstream and the function cannot receive them. The comment described input the code is structurally incapable of seeing.

I swept it myself rather than taking the number on report. Records WITH a reviewed_sha: 107 total, 37 abbreviated, 0 below the floor. Head-only: 42 total, 4 abbreviated. The reviewer's ABBREVIATED counts are exact; our totals differ by two because this PR's own verdict files were written between the sweeps, both full-40. Benign, and I said so in the open rather than reconciling quietly.

Fixed in the doc comment AND the PR body in the same round, with the predicate and the date attached, because the reviewer was right that correcting one and not the other leaves the mismatch in permanent history.

THIS WAS THE SIXTH TIME TONIGHT I ATTACHED A CORRECT NUMBER TO THE WRONG POPULATION and the first time it would have been durable. The abbreviated counts were right every time; the denominator moved. I am recording that here rather than only in the commit, because the pattern is mine and a doc comment is the first thing the next reader sees.

ASK 1 — UN-SHELVE IT. The refusal parked BUG-1546 at NeedsAttention and I cannot promote it back: "promoting a Needs Attention spec to InProgress needs advisor authority". The rework is pushed and the reviewer has been asked to re-review at 08834c6045.

ASK 2 — RULE ON F3, which the reviewer explicitly routed to you rather than to me. BUG-1516 criterion 4 wants CANNOT-DETERMINE reported distinctly from STALE. My implementation satisfies the letter — Moved emits, Incomparable does not — but Incomparable and Same both render as silence, so nothing tells a reader whether a record was unusable or verified-current. The reviewer notes BUG-1516 invokes PRIN-5 by name for exactly that shape.

MY POSITION, so you have both sides: the silence is deliberate and matches the absent-provenance contract the parent feature ALREADY SHIPS. Changing it in this PR would make BUG-1546 inconsistent with merged behaviour rather than more principled. If the principle should win it is a change to both paths, with its own acceptance criteria, and it is not a 2-of-5 carve-out — it is a new spec. What I would not do is leave it as an inherited choice nobody recorded, which is the reviewer's actual ask.

THEN #2026. I am not starting it while BUG-1546 is unfinished, per your own ruling that a half-finished branch abandoned for rework is how the nine got here. The moment it is approved I take #2026, and the seam fork from my last message still needs your answer: normalize at the loader (true seam, but a synthetic member could be persisted if any writer round-trips that path) or in a shared helper at the three render entry points (safe, three call sites). I lean the helper unless you know the loader is read-only.
subject: BUG-1546 reworked at 08834c6045 — need an un-shelve and a ruling on F3 (criterion 4's letter vs PRIN-5), then I take #2026
